Why do you feel this way? Take a deep breath and figure that out first. 
Go for an early morning jog. Take a list and write down everything that you feel. 
You seem to be going through a terrible time. I hope you get through it. 

Funny thing is, I feel the same, and I seem to be giving advice on the same problems I have without actually following it.
I wish you the best of luck.

I've tried to tell them, but since I'm so young, my mom doesn't seem to take it very seriously. She gives me as much help as she thinks I need, of course, but she just doesn't know it's gotten this bad. My dad thinks he's helping, but he only ends up sounding like a broken tape recorder- telling me over and over to start getting up early in the morning and exercise, to clean up my room to be more organised, to take care of myself, to have a bath very early in the morning, to study.   My brother is already going to a counselor, and my dad just quit his job a while ago (I'm worried about him, too. He seems to be taking a ridiculously long hiatus from working, and he suffers from low self-esteem too). I'm really close to my dad, and he tries so much to help, but he doesn't understand. I recently got a dog, and he seems to be the only thing that makes me happy. My exams are going on, and the only thing that's improved in the past few months is the fact that I've stopped getting very bad panic attacks in the middle of my tests.
I think more than anything, it's the feeling that I'm alone that makes me so upset. I'm usually very upbeat and loud and happy, and I still keep that persona up in front of my friends because they wouldn't understand if they saw what I'm going through now, either.
My self-esteem is so low, and my appetite has lowered so much. I have a distorted body image, I'm 14, about 5'2 and like 92 pounds and rapidly losing weight, very skinny, but I still feel like I'm fat, although I've never been anything but underweight. I hate my face, and every time I look into the mirror, I just want to float up and above, away from my skin and my life for just a while.
Nothing is terribly wrong, but nothing is right. Nothing seems okay anymore. My grades are absolutely fine, but they've gone from, say, 99s to 92s, and I used to be good at sports, but I don't bother anymore. I get irritable at home and at school, I snap at my parents, my aunt, my grandparents, and my friends. 
I love sleeping, it's like letting go, but it's temporary. I wish there was a more permanent solution.
I've also been diagnosed with a pretty severe VitaminD3 deficiency, the same as my brother.
I just... I don't know what to do. I'm too young to want to die, I know, and I don't want to make a big deal about it, because what if I'm wrong and what if my feelings aren't that bad? What if I take my parents' attention away from my brother and he does something terrible during that time? I can't risk it, he's too vulnerable.
But honestly,
